findings.summary: The screen description now carries the previous log's Met this goal choice into the new form, but the unchanged MetGoalCheckbox node still says the checkbox defaults unchecked.
findings.evidence: screen.logContact: "channel, depth and the Met this goal choice carry over" vs component.MetGoalCheckbox: "Met this goal defaults unchecked and is disabled when no current goal exists"

findings.summary: Pre-checking Met this goal from the previous log lets an event qualify without the owner explicitly marking it, which undermines the requirement that qualification needs an explicit owner mark.
findings.evidence: S.webapp.qualification: "A ContactEvent must qualify only when the owner explicitly marks that it met this goal"; diff: "the Met this goal choice carry over"

findings.summary: Journey step c4 says the form opens prefilled, but c4 is on screen.person and the form lives on screen.logContact; the spec also never says what the form contains when there is no previous log.
findings.evidence: c4: "action: Log what happened? The form opens prefilled from the previous log ... screen: screen.person"
